open_questions.rubric: consistent: the same words, or a pattern that changes only with the page or item ("Chapter 2" / "Chapter 3"), or the same name with a description that only adds the current state. inconsistent: different words for the same action or destination ("Sign in" / "Log in", "Save page" / "Save", "Help" / "Support"), or one side has no name. different_function: the match is wrong, they do different things (one opens a menu, the other searches; different goes_to addresses; or names that name different things, like section menus "Artemis" and "Careers").
